outing.hero_prompt_english: Beijing International Flower Port in Shunyi: a broad landscaped lake edged with curving beds of autumn chrysanthemums, warm grasses and airy park trees. A visitor stops at the flower border with a small notebook. A few saturated flower patches amid real green planting, not impossible endless fields or spring tulips. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.

art_repair.reason: The generated image makes three monumental interlocking leaf-shaped glazed halls the central landmark. The approved plan was a lake and flower-border outing; this dominant architecture is not established by the verified tourism sources and could falsely identify the venue. Native lake, flowers and paper treatment otherwise work. Prefer the defensible landscape without unverified building silhouette.
